stories.title: Sins of Sincerity
stories.description: In a post-plague city ruled by an oppressive Church that treats desire as a sin, faithless Sister Eliza survives by performing a piety she doesn't feel. Her double life unravels when she falls for a forbidden dragon-kin leader and joins a hidden faction fighting for self-truth. As the Church escalates a genocidal propaganda campaign, Eliza must abandon her invisibility to protect her love and wage a quiet war for salvation.
